types.name: Fenrir::Rect2D
types.doc: A rectangle in local 2D coordinates: logical units from the top-left, Y down.

types.name: Fenrir::ElementBoxes
types.doc: An element's laid-out rectangles, in UI units from its root's top-left, before any transform: its border box, padding box (inside the border) and content box (inside the padding), and the clip its ancestors' `overflow: hidden` sets on it (their padding boxes intersected; the root's whole box when none clips).

types.name: Fenrir::ElementId
types.doc: An element id (ADR-0066): an index and a version naming one element of a UI root. Removing the element makes it stale, and a slot used again gets a new version, so a stale id never names the new element. It is not an entity. Default constructed, it names nothing.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: The element's slot in its root.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: The slot's version when the element was made.

types.name: Fenrir::Key
types.doc: A key code: which key was pressed as the keyboard layout names it. The key that types Z on an AZERTY keyboard is `Key::W` on QWERTY and `Key::Z` on AZERTY. Use it for shortcuts named by letter. A key the layout names with a character outside this list is `Unknown`.

values.name: Count
values.doc: How many keys there are, `Unknown` included: a size, not a key.

types.name: Fenrir::MouseButton
types.doc: A mouse button. `X1` and `X2` are the side buttons, back and forward.

values.name: Count
values.doc: How many mouse buttons there are: a size, not a button.

types.name: Fenrir::RemoveMode
types.doc: How UIRoot::Remove takes an element away.

values.name: Outro
values.doc: Give it `:outro`, and remove it once its and its descendants' transitions have ended (ADR-0066).

values.name: Immediate
values.doc: Remove it and everything under it at once.

types.name: Fenrir::ScaleRule
types.doc: How a UI root maps its UI units to its target's logical units (the scale rule).

values.name: Height1080
values.doc: 1080 UI units span the target's pixel height: scale = pixel height / 1080 / content scale logical units per UI unit, so a UI authored at 1080p keeps its proportions at every resolution.

values.name: ContentScale
values.doc: One UI unit is one logical unit, which follows the operating system's content scale.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptPainter::PainterId
types.doc: A painter over the window overlay (Painter.Overlay), which the engine keeps while the C# system that got it runs: a number, so copying it copies no painter. Every Painter call takes one. When the system returns, what it painted is submitted to the overlay and the painter ends; its id is never handed out again, so a later call on it does nothing. The default names none.

types.name: Fenrir::WindowId
types.doc: Which window an input came from. A plain number chosen by whoever feeds the input (FenrirWindow, which keys its windows by it, or a test); FenrirInput only compares it.

types.name: Fenrir::ScriptUI::RootSettings
types.doc: What a script makes a UI root with (UIRoot.Create): a root on a window's overlay at a layer, blending in the overlay's gamma space. A root drawn into an image or the world is made in C++.

fields.name: window
fields.doc: The window whose overlay it draws on.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: The overlay layer it draws on; roots draw lowest layer first, then in the order they were made.

fields.name: scaleRule
fields.doc: How its UI units map to the window's logical units.

fields.name: snapToPixels
fields.doc: Snap laid-out rectangles to whole pixels.

fields.name: inputPriority
fields.doc: Its input router's priority: routers run highest first, so give a root drawn over another a higher one.

fields.name: defaultStylesheet
fields.doc: Give it FenrirUI's default stylesheet before its own sheets.

fields.name: virtualCursor
fields.doc: Start with the virtual cursor on: the left stick moves the pointer and A clicks under it.

fields.name: hotReload
fields.doc: Start with hot reload on: the files it loads are polled for changes.

types.name: Fenrir::UIEventKind
types.doc: What happened to a UIEvent's target.

values.name: PointerEnter
values.doc: The pointer came over the target: it is now the topmost element under the pointer that takes it.

values.name: PointerLeave
values.doc: The pointer left the target.

values.name: PointerMove
values.doc: The pointer moved over the target.

values.name: PointerPress
values.doc: A mouse button went down over the target.

values.name: PointerRelease
values.doc: A mouse button pressed over the target went up, wherever the pointer is now.

values.name: Click
values.doc: A button was pressed and released over the target.

values.name: DoubleClick
values.doc: The second click of a button on the target in quick succession, sent after its Click.

values.name: Scroll
values.doc: The wheel turned over the target.

values.name: KeyPress
values.doc: A key went down, or repeated, while the target had the focus.

values.name: KeyRelease
values.doc: A key went up while the target had the focus.

values.name: TextInput
values.doc: A codepoint was typed while the target had the focus.

values.name: Focus
values.doc: The target took the focus.

values.name: Blur
values.doc: The target lost the focus.

values.name: Change
values.doc: A control's value changed. Sent by the controls.

values.name: Submit
values.doc: A control was submitted, such as Enter in a text entry. Sent by the controls.

values.name: DocumentReloaded
values.doc: A markup document was loaded again into the target's place. Sent by hot reload.

values.name: Cancel
values.doc: B on a gamepad (its East button) was pressed while the target had the focus: back out of it.

types.name: Fenrir::UIRootId
types.doc: Names a UI root; UIRoots gives each root its own when it is made. Zero names none.

types.name: Fenrir::UIEvent
types.doc: A UI event (ADR-0065): an engine event (ADR-0012) a UI root sends once for each thing that happens to one of its elements, read through `EventReader<UIEvent>`. It is sent at its target only; listeners on the target's ancestors see it as it bubbles, the queue does not. Plain data.

fields.name: root
fields.doc: The root whose element it happened to.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Where the pointer is, in the root's UI units from its top-left, for every kind.

fields.name: button
fields.doc: The mouse button, for a press, release, click or double click.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The key, for a key press or release.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The vertical wheel notches for a scroll (positive away from the user), 1 for a key press that is a held key's repeat, and a control's value for a change.

fields.name: integer
fields.doc: The modifiers (KeyModifiers' bits) for a key press or release, the codepoint for text input, and the click count for a click (1) or double click (2).
